prompts.name: plan_trip
prompts.title: Plan a budget-bound trip
prompts.description: Plan a trip from origin to destination within a fixed budget by calling `search_multitransport` and `search_hotels`. The model is expected to choose the cheapest viable transport, then size the hotel cap from the remainder.

arguments.name: budget_rub
arguments.description: Total trip budget in RUB (one person).
